metadata.urbanContextTemporalCaveat: The 2020 built-up layer is used only for deterministic logistics-relevance screening, not as a model feature or event-time urban reconstruction.
metadata.selectionPolicy: Select at most one eligible GAUL level-2 region per event, ranked by built-up flood area, total flood area, valid observation, then stable region ID.
metadata.selectionTiming: Criteria fixed before OSM extraction or road-corridor labels.
